subject: Re: Short-term quota elevation + billing spread for launch
messages:
From: Cara Monroe <cara@lumenix.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term quota elevation + billing smoothing for launch

Hi Sean,

Quick note from the Lumenix launch team — we have a hard launch on 2025-08-07 and expect a concentrated spike in inference volume for ~72 hours. Our baseline is ~120M tokens/day; projected peak could reach ~600M tokens/day during the first 48 hours.

We need two things from Redwood to avoid throttles:
- A short-term quota/headroom increase for the 8/7–8/10 window
- A billing path that smooths the financial impact (we'd prefer a blended rate or invoice spread rather than an immediate large overrun charge)

Attached is a quick usage calc (Lumenix_Escalation_Usage_Calc.xlsx) showing expected delta.

Can Redwood offer a capped overrun option (a hard cap on Lumenix liability for the window) or a temporary reserved headroom (we'd pay a short term fee)? Also please confirm whether an SLA/latency commitment changes under either option.

Procurement copied here (procurement@lumenix.com) — they can issue a PO if we get terms.

Thanks,
Cara
Cara Monroe
Head of Product, Lumenix
cara@lumenix.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Cara Monroe <cara@lumenix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term quota elevation + billing smoothing for launch

Hi Cara — thanks for the detail and attachment. We can support this; below are two pragmatic options and the tradeoffs so procurement can choose quickly:

Option A — Temporary reserved headroom (recommended if you want predictable cost and capacity):
- We reserve an additional 2.5x of your baseline capacity for 2025-08-07 through 2025-08-10.
- Discount: 25% off standard pay-as-you-go rate for tokens consumed from the reserved headroom during the window.
- Billing: usage from headroom billed as usual; large bursts are expected and priced at the discounted headroom rate.
- Requires a short amendment and PO.

Option B — Ad-hoc quota bump + capped overrun true-up (recommended if you want minimal upfront commitment):
- We temporarily raise your quota for the window without a reserve.
- Overrun liability is capped to a fixed dollar amount for the period (we can discuss cap levels).
- Overrun billed at a premium rate but we can offer a partial credit back (soft discount) if you commit to a follow-on monthly minimum after the window.
- No reserve PO required upfront, but we need acknowledgement of capped liability in writing.

SLA impact: both options maintain our standard availability SLA; latency SLOs can be preserved for customers on Dedicated or with reserved headroom. For ad-hoc bumps there is a slightly higher risk of transient throttling under extreme cluster contention — we'll prioritize headroom customers first.

Next steps: I attached a short proposal summary (Redwood-Proposal-Summary.pdf). If procurement provides a PO for Option A we can fast-track the headroom and send an amendment for signature. If you prefer Option B, tell us the cap Lumenix is comfortable with and we'll provide the capped overrun amendment.

cc'ing Laura and Ben to confirm the cap tiers and billing smoothing cadence.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Cara Monroe <cara@lumenix.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term quota elevation + billing smoothing for launch

Thanks Sean — Option A sounds attractive. A couple quick clarifications before procurement issues a PO:
- Can Redwood provide a hard cap on total overrun liability in the event we exceed the reserved headroom? We need a worst-case exposure number for our finance team.
- If we take Option A, will the headroom guarantee be honored across regions (we have users in EU as well)? For this launch we mostly need US region but want fallback.

If you can give a cap number and confirm US-first priority with EU fallback, procurement will prepare a PO today.

—Cara
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Cara Monroe <cara@lumenix.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term quota elevation + billing smoothing for launch

Hi Cara — Laura from Sales Ops here. Helpful context — here's what we can commit if you choose Option A and supply a PO by EOD Aug 3:

- Reserved headroom: additional 2.5x baseline (US region primary).
- Hard overrun exposure cap: $8,000 for the 2025-08-07 to 2025-08-10 window. Any usage beyond the reserved headroom that would otherwise generate charges above that amount will be absorbed by Redwood up to that cap.
- Blended discount: 25% off PAYG rate for tokens consumed from the reserved headroom.
- Invoice smoothing: we can split any remaining net overrun charge across the Aug and Sep invoices (finance-approved).
- Amendment: short amendment required to attach to your current agreement; draft attached (amendment-draft.pdf).

If that works, please have Procurement issue a PO referencing deal LUM-2025-07-31 and route the PO to billing@redwood.com. We will generate a DocuSign amendment and turnaround for signature within 24 hours of PO receipt.

Ben, please confirm finance approval for the invoice split (cc'd).

Thanks —
Laura Bennett

DocuSign link will be generated once PO is attached to the HubSpot deal (Deal ID: LUM-2025-07-31). Please reference internal billing code LUMX-001 on the PO to ensure correct routing.

1) Lock-in reserved headroom for 8/7–8/10 (US region primary, EU fallback noted)
2) Send DocuSign amendment (same-day)
3) Confirm allocation and monitoring hooks so your SREs can call our support channel if they see throttles
